rv.q: Worse, Nasr puts into words what Anvari implies: that the djinn is the manifestation of Shideh's frustrations.
Nadia Latif directs Carmen Nasr’s stage adaptation of writer-filmmaker Babak Anvari’s celebrated Middle-Eastern spine tingler UNDER THE SHADOW from 2016.
Under the Shadow is proof that the stage can be every bit as scary as the cinema.

cn.t: Horror adaptation delivers quality scares and one devastating theatrical moment that had audiences screaming, though reception remains mixed overall with some critics more impressed than others.
